description: This file provides functions for managing NAND flash upgrade processes in OpenWrt, including handling UBI and UBIFS images, partition and volume management, and upgrade workflows.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates device node for a given UBI volume directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds and returns the basename of a UBI volume matching the provided UBI device and volume name.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device associated with a given partition name.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a given file, used for identifying file types.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a tar archive, used for identification.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the file type based on its magic number, used for NAND images.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the file type within tar archive based on magic number.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if the given file is gzip compressed and returns 'z' if so.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from a backup file into UBI volume.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a UBI block device if it exists.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches UBI to a partition, formatting and creating volumes if necessary.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches UBI from a partition and removes associated UBI blocks.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for upgrade, creating and resizing as needed.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Writes a ubinized image to the UBI partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Updates the UBIFS volume with a new image.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Updates a UBI volume with a FIT image.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Extracts images from a tar archive and writes them to partitions or volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of a gzip compressed file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Detects file type and performs corresponding upgrade process.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration after upgrade.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to process firmware upgrade with verification and reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Actions upon successful upgrade including restoring configuration and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Actions upon failed upgrade including logging and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the provided file is a valid upgrade image for the current platform.
